answer: At registration, each agent stakes a forty-token bond and registers a unique device nonce. The gatekeeper agent verifies the bond exists and scans the glacier state for duplicate nonces at that exact moment. If a match is found, the system slashes the bond immediately and writes the fraud record to the shale ledger. Because each seat pays only five tokens while the deposit is forty, any cloned identity loses thirty-five tokens per attempt. The pulse mechanism ensures the slash executes before the next block is sealed.
